name: wp-json-schemas
description: JSON schemas for WordPress PHP objects and REST API responses
author: John Blackbourn

scripts.release: f() { npm version --no-git-tag-version "$1" && npm run version-sync && v=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git commit -am "$v" && git tag "$v"; }; f
scripts.version-sync: npm version --no-git-tag-version --prefix packages/wp-types $(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git add packages/wp-types/package.json packages/wp-types/package-lock.json
